styles.name: Black wide waist apron with pocket right side as worn, cut-out centre front split with facing, self fabric ties — London Linen, no Tibard branding
styles.desc: WIDE WAIST APRON · Pocket 16 x 16 cm, right side as worn · Cut-out centre front split with facing, stay tape across the top of the split · Self fabric waist ties · No Tibard branding · No embroidery
fabrics: Black 65% polyester / 35% cotton 195 gsm (P and R) — rating 1.10 m; the sheet names PC2003 at B11, All Costings has the sustainable PC2003ECO at 1.10 m
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 — cost per metre
65% polyester / 35% cotton · 60° wash · no bleach · 2 dot iron · tumble dry · P dry clean. Set 4 cm down from the finished right side seam as worn. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
Cut at 2.5 cm, set with the stitching across the top of the split to secure it. No Sage code on the sheet.
mfg: Make the waist ties: fold in half and enclose the raw edges, box one end and edgestitch the long edge.
Double turn the side seams and topstitch 1 cm.
Double turn the top of the apron and topstitch 2 cm. Insert the waist ties; backtack the stitching of the waist ties to secure.
Set the facing to the split. Trim into the corners and turn through. Set the stay tape (cut at 2.5 cm) with the stitching across the top of the split to secure. Split 1 cm wide at the top.
Turn in to neaten the facing edge and topstitch down to form a 12 mm topstitch of the split all round.
Double turn the hem and topstitch 1 cm.
Set the pocket hem: double turn 1 + 2 cm and topstitch at 2 cm.
Set the pocket to the right side as worn: top of the pocket 35 cm in from the finished side seam and 22 cm down from the finished top edge. No triangle tack, as the pocket is bartacked.
fin: Bartack the top of the split to secure: 1 long horizontal bartack (or 2 short bartacks) across the top of the split.
Bartack the top of the pocket x 2.
Check, trim and fold in tens.
styles.note: Works order S851569 for SNSAPP052803, London Linen, issued by Lara 22/1/26, required 20/2/26 for 250 (JH created for SR1119; amended for SR1124 JH 24/5/23; created for bulk 15/6/23 JH; corrected to a 1 cm hem as the sample was approved jh 22/6/23; marker details updated re AC jh 20/6/24). No Tibard branding and no embroidery. Rating 1.10 m, the same as All Costings on PC2003ECO; the sheet names the marker APP0528PKT but the cutting room's lay plan has no entry for it. The sheet's sketch is in works-orders/SNSAPP052803-LondonLinen.xlsx.
